timing: Before executing the new sensitivity calculations; after independent design review of existing scripts/source rows

changes.replacement: Omit genome-wide Rap/Pro versus Qui/Pro correlation and percentile ranks. Direct BUB1B feature-level Rap/Pro, Qui/Pro and Rap/Qui comparisons remain.
changes.reason: Shared-denominator mathematical coupling, dependent overlapping features and denominator-based filtering make this nonessential statistic easily misleading; it cannot establish proliferation confounding.

changes.addition: Report median of the within-context median paired differences as an equal-context-weighted descriptive estimand, separately from the primary variant-row-weighted median.
changes.reason: Design audit found duplicate six-base contexts; rows must not be represented as independent contexts.

unchanged: Source hashes, nearest-context selection, all original comparisons, row/group leave-out reporting, GSE thresholds and sample-dependence diagnostics, no new p-values/CIs/causal adjustment, post-hoc exploratory status.
